sections.title: 1. N+1 Query Patterns
sections.content: **No N+1 database queries found** — this is a frontend-only static portfolio with no database layer. However, there are related API-fetching issues:

sections.title: 🔴 Critical: `GitHubStats.jsx:14-35` — No API response caching
🟡 Medium: `Blog.jsx:7-36` — Array created on every render
🟡 Medium: `Navbar.jsx:68-72` — `useCallback` stale closure
🟡 Medium: `App.jsx:104-106` — Redundant effect for language sync
🟡 Medium: `Aurora.jsx:200-203` — Color conversion on every frame
🟢 Low: `Footer.jsx:37` — `new Date()` on every render
sections.content:
```jsx
const year = new Date().getFullYear()
```

**Fix**: Extract to a module-level constant:

```jsx
const CURRENT_YEAR = new Date().getFullYear()
```

---

sections.title: 🔴 Critical: `SplashCursor.jsx:89-103` — O(n²) per-frame connection drawing
🔴 Critical: `Contact.jsx:83-103` — No abort on unmount
🟡 Medium: `useCanvasLifecycle.js:78` — Unused idle timeout
sections.content:
**Issue**: The `idleRef.current` is cleared in cleanup but never assigned — the idle timeout/detection logic is never activated. `handleActivity` tracks `lastActivityRef` but `isIdleRef` never becomes true because no idle timer is ever set. This means the pause/resume on visibility/intersection is active but the idle timeout optimization does nothing.

---

sections.title: 🔴 Critical: `SplashCursor.jsx:74-77` — Per-frame string concatenation for gradient colors
sections.content:
```jsx
const alpha = d.life * 0.5
gradient.addColorStop(0, d.color + Math.round(alpha * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
gradient.addColorStop(0.5, d.color + Math.round(alpha * 0.3 * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
```

**Issue**: Every frame creates 2 hex color strings per drop through `toString(16).padStart(2)`. Pre-convert the colors to RGBA arrays to avoid string operations.

**Fix**: Store colors as RGB tuples and use `rgba()`:

```jsx
const COLORS_RGB = {
  '#6C63FF': [108, 99, 255],
  '#00D4FF': [0, 212, 255],
  '#FF6B9D': [255, 107, 157],
}

// In addDrop:
size: Math.random() * 15 + 5,
life: 1,
rgb: Object.values(COLORS_RGB)[Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)],

// In animate:
const alpha = d.life * 0.5
const r = d.rgb[0], g = d.rgb[1], b = d.rgb[2]
gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`)
gradient.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha * 0.3})`)
gradient.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},0)`)
```

sections.title: 🟡 Medium: `Typewriter.jsx:16-45` — Rapid timer churn
🟢 Low: `App.jsx:43-38` — Lenis `requestAnimationFrame` always running
Summary by Severity
sections.content:
| Severity | File | Issue |
|----------|------|-------|
| 🔴 **Critical** | SplashCursor.jsx:89-103 | O(n²) per-frame connection drawing + unbounded drops array |
| 🔴 **Critical** | SplashCursor.jsx:74-77 | Per-frame string concatenation for gradient colors |
| 🔴 **Critical** | Contact.jsx:83-103 | Memory leak on unmount during email send |
| 🟡 **Medium** | GitHubStats.jsx:14-35 | No API response caching + inaccurate contribution metric |
| 🟡 **Medium** | Aurora.jsx:200-203 | Color objects recreated on every animation frame |
| 🟡 **Medium** | Blog.jsx:7-36 | Static posts array recreated on every render |
| 🟡 **Medium** | Navbar.jsx:68-72 | Stale closure risk in `useCallback` for language toggle |
| 🟡 **Medium** | App.jsx:43-38 | Continuous RAF even when idle on Lenis scroll |
| 🟡 **Medium** | useCanvasLifecycle.js:39 | Idle timeout logic never triggers (dead code) |
| 🟢 **Low** | Footer.jsx:37 | `new Date()` on every render |
| 🟢 **Low** | App.jsx:104-106 | Redundant i18n sync effect on mount |
| 🟢 **Low** | Typewriter.jsx:16-45 | Rapid timer create/cancel cycle (acceptable for animation) |

The **highest impact** changes are addressing the SplashCursor O(n²) loop (which will cause visible jank during sustained interaction), the Aurora per-frame color conversion (wasteful GPU uniform updates), and the Contact form unmount leak. The `GitHubStats` caching is the quickest win for perceived performance — right now every page navigation to that section re-fetches from GitHub.
